title: Deliver a lightweight mobile content-and-exercises experience
notes:
Manny Rayner confirmed on 2026-08-12 that mobile access is most important initially for Sophie's Indigenous users, while being broadly wanted. The desired first outcome is a lightweight mobile experience for browsing content and using exercises before mid-September 2026. Sophie would be very happy with that scope. First perform a bounded technical/product discussion and effort assessment, then define the smallest usable slice and acceptance checks across representative content and exercises. Coordinate with the mobile-access roadmap, picture-dictionary workflows, and the legacy catalogue mobile corpus audit rather than assuming full mobile authoring in the first cut.

Human issue-review update from Manny Rayner on 2026-08-13: Delivery before Sophie’s 24 August visit is not realistic. Retain mid-September as the useful target so mobile browsing and exercises can potentially be included in the planned ComputEL-10 paper due in early October; Sophie is very keen on this paper.
